extracted.intended_audience: journal production staff, XML/markup engineers, and editors preparing JATS article backmatter for Taylor & Francis (T&F) publications
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for encoding Open Science badges in JATS XML: where to place an Open Scholarship backmatter section, what sec-type attribute values to use (including badge identifiers), and example markup for badge graphics and links.

rubrics_metrics.name: Presence and title of Open Scholarship backmatter
rubrics_metrics.description: Articles that have been awarded one or more Open Science badges should contain a backmatter section titled “Open Scholarship”.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Open Scholarship section should be placed directly below the data availability statement section within the <back> element of the article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Open Scholarship sec-type attribute
rubrics_metrics.description: The Open Scholarship section should have a @sec-type attribute value of open-scholarship.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The badges awarded will also be identified within the section @sec-type attribute of the open scholarship section. The values in @sec-type should be separated by space characters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Badge-specific sec-type values (use badge identifiers in sec-type)
rubrics_metrics.description: Each badge maps to a specific @sec-type token (e.g., open-data, open-materials, preregistered).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: an article awarded the Open Data Badge should have @sec-type="open-scholarship open-data"; an article awarded all three available badges should have sec-type="open-scholarship open-data open-materials preregistered".

rubrics_metrics.name: Placement and ordering relative to Data Availability statement
rubrics_metrics.description: The Open Scholarship section must be placed directly below the data availability statement section within the <back> element.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure the Open Scholarship <sec> follows the data availability statement in the document structure so readers and downstream processors find badge information immediately after data availability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Text contents and badge graphics supplied by production staff
rubrics_metrics.description: The text contents of the Open Scholarship section and badge graphics will vary from article to article and will be supplied by T&F production staff.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not assume fixed wording or graphics from authors; production will provide the appropriate badge images and the finalized text. Examples in the guide show production-supplied inline-graphic elements and ext-links to resources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Include inline-graphic and ext-link markup for badges and resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Examples show using <inline-graphic xlink:href='...'> for badge images and <ext-link ext-link-type='uri' xlink:href='...'> for links to data, materials, and registrations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the example markup patterns: include inline-graphic elements for badge images (with xlink:href referring to the image asset) and ext-link elements pointing to DOIs or OSF URLs for the underlying data/materials/registrations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide links to data/materials/registrations in Open Scholarship section
rubrics_metrics.description: When badges are awarded, the Open Scholarship text includes links to the resources: e.g., 'The data and materials are openly accessible at https://doi.org/...' or 'https://osf.io/...'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use ext-link elements to provide the canonical URIs (DOI or OSF) for data, materials, and preregistrations so they are machine-actionable and human-readable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contact for author's disclosure form
rubrics_metrics.description: To obtain the author's disclosure form, please contact the Editor.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include this or analogous contact instruction in the Open Scholarship text when production supplies the badge text, as in the example for Open Data.

rubrics_metrics.name: Canonical list of Center for Open Science badges and their sec-type tokens
rubrics_metrics.description: The guide lists Open Science Badges from the Center for Open Science and the corresponding @sec-type values; only badges with “yes” in the Available column are available for use on TFO.
rubrics_metrics.guidance:
Current entries in the table (name → @sec-type → available):
- Open Data → open-data → yes
- Open Data (Protected Access) → open-data-pa → no
- Open Materials → open-materials → yes
- Preregistered → preregistered → yes
(Several compound/variant preregistered tokens such as preregistered-ap, preregistered-de, preregistered-tc, etc., are listed with availability 'no'). Use only the tokens that are marked available for TFO.

rubrics_metrics.name: Badge assets provenance
rubrics_metrics.description: The badge names and logo images are from https://osf.io/tvyxz/.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When sourcing or referencing badge image assets, note the indicated provenance; production staff will supply the actual graphics as noted elsewhere in the guide.
